issues.description: Payment card details processed directly without idempotency key or PCI-DSS tokenization.
issues.suggestion: Use a tokenized payment provider (such as Stripe) rather than accepting and passing raw card numbers.

issues.description: Credit card validation only checks length and lacks Luhn algorithm verification (mod 10 checksum).
issues.suggestion: Implement the Luhn algorithm to reject invalid credit card numbers before invoking payment processing.

issues.description: Expiry date calculation sets date to first day of month, prematurely rejecting cards valid until end of month.
issues.suggestion: Construct expiry date with last day of the expiration month: new Date(2000 + year, month, 0, 23, 59, 59).

issues.description: Floating point arithmetic for subscription calculations introduces monetary precision rounding errors.
issues.suggestion: Store and calculate currency amounts in integer cents (e.g. 999 instead of 9.99).

issues.description: Subscription features stored as stringified JSON in database column without schema validation.
issues.suggestion: Validate feature list against strict enum schema before persistence or use relational mapping.

codeQuality.summary: Significant financial and security risks identified in new subscription model. Untokenized card processing and date calculation bugs.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Critical financial payment processing workflow has no automated test coverage.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: test("processPremiumPayment succeeds with valid payment and upgrades subscription")

untestedPaths.reasoning: Card validation branches could permit expired or malformed cards.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: test("validatePaymentDetails rejects expired cards and invalid CVV formats")

untestedPaths.reasoning: Tax and processing fee computation logic must be verified for accuracy.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: test("calculateSubscriptionPrice calculates correct total for premium and enterprise tiers")

untestedPaths.reasoning: Access control gate for premium features lacks test coverage.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: test("hasFeatureAccess permits valid subscriber and blocks expired subscriber")

untestedPaths.reasoning: Subscription deserialization and null checks are untested.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: test("getUserSubscription returns null for non-subscribers and object for subscribers")

testCoverage.summary: Zero test coverage for entire new premium subscription module (190 lines of critical business logic).

suggestions.description: Introduce PaymentGateway interface with Strategy pattern to isolate external payment provider.
suggestions.before: async function chargeCard(payment: PaymentDetails, amount: number): Promise<boolean> { ... }
suggestions.benefits: Enables mocking in unit tests and simplifies switching payment providers without editing business logic.

suggestions.description: Extract Money value object to encapsulate currency calculations and tax rounding rules.
suggestions.before: const tax = basePrice * TAX_RATE; const fee = basePrice * PROCESSING_FEE;
suggestions.benefits: Prevents floating point rounding errors in financial transactions.

refactorings.summary: Extract payment processing into dedicated payment gateway service and use value objects for currency operations.

recommendations.description: Implement comprehensive unit test suite in tests/premium.test.ts before deploying billing features.
Replace raw card number handling with tokenized gateway integration (e.g. Stripe Elements).
Fix card expiration date calculation and implement Luhn algorithm verification.
